verdict.rationale: Customer.io's official MCP server and CLI let an agent create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and draft messages. Broadcasts can be queued to send at a specified time, so an agent can plausibly build a segment-targeted campaign and leave it scheduled. However, nothing documents a human approval or review gate before send. The only approval mentioned is the MCP client approving read and write tool categories, which is not a send sign-off. Missing for 10: a documented draft or pending-approval state for agent-built campaigns, an explicit human approve-before-send workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agents scheduling sends.
